svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Print: a foot 88 x 25 x 5 mm and an upright 88 x 8 x 62 mm,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 15 mm back from the foot's front edge, printed lying on its back.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Window 64 x 28 mm in the upright, 22 mm up, for the display's pins.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two 3 mm pilot holes in the foot, 6 mm in from each end and 7 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: from the front, for M3 screws from under the plate.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Three 7 mm holes in the foot's front strip, 25 mm apart, for the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: panel-mount push buttons, held by their nuts.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the display module screws to the upright's front face with its

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: four corner holes (M2.5 or M3 self-tappers).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the 86 x 50 mm display board sits flat on the upright.
